entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-06-27
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • JSON collection mapped to nullable reference collection fails on JSON `null` token (`Invalid token type: 'Null'`) #38454
    11.0.0
  • Add code coverage report to AzDo #24990
    MQ
  • OriginalValue access on ComplexCollections not working for Entites in Added State #38486
    11.0.0
  • Allow Shared Columns with ComplexType #38485
  • Microsoft nugets version mismatched in preview versions when using EF Core SqlServer #38478
  • EF Core 10 parameter-name simplification (@__p_0 → @p) and SQL Server plan-cache recompilation on upgrade #38483

Updated

  • SQLite vulnerbilities #38257
    10.0.11
  • Improve exceptions for invalid JSON values in JSON column #35863
    Backlog
  • Result of left joining a nullable nominal type should be null (i.e. no instance) and not an instance with all null property values #22517
    Backlog
  • Bundle-Migration errors with "cannot access file...being used by another process" #25555
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Improve handling of null values in JSON properties mapped to primitive collections #38498
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38497
  • [release/11.0-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #38496

Merged

  • Generate and upload code coverage reports #38482
  • Fix OriginalValues.ToObject for added complex collections #38493
    community-contribution

Updated

  • Unload target assemblies before publishing the migrations bundle #38456
    community-contribution
